<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s).

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`  _(via object_extension (literal, a string literal in objectExtensionWriteFold; a string literal in runStackExpressionPasses; a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via AUTHORING_RULES (symbol, a top-level const object), runtimeTypes (symbol, a field of const object AUTHORING_RULES), object_extension (literal, a string literal in objectExtensionWriteFold; a string literal in runStackExpressionPasses; a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class), object_extension (literal, a string literal in objectExtensionWriteFold; a string literal in runStackExpressionPasses; a string literal in runtimeTypes))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via object_extension (literal, a string literal in objectExtensionWriteFold; a string literal in runStackExpressionPasses; a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-4.mdx`  _(via object_extension (literal, a string literal in objectExtensionWriteFold; a string literal in runStackExpressionPasses; a string literal in runtimeTypes))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **173** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f5121e84d56d4e92a4cc40171c65dab84d801b89` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8889d9021bc5f416c9d64f231d0c51f49019bd6e` — the merge of head `bb8a46225eb8eef07f93863a1adba76b3976e0e1` into base `f5121e84d56d4e92a4cc40171c65dab84d801b89`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8889d9021bc5f416c9d64f231d0c51f49019bd6e && git checkout 8889d9021bc5f416c9d64f231d0c51f49019bd6e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f5121e84d56d4e92a4cc40171c65dab84d801b89 bb8a46225eb8eef07f93863a1adba76b3976e0e1 && git checkout -B drift-repro f5121e84d56d4e92a4cc40171c65dab84d801b89 && git merge --no-ff bb8a46225eb8eef07f93863a1adba76b3976e0e1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f5121e84d56d4e92a4cc40171c65dab84d801b89
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f5121e84d56d4e92a4cc40171c65dab84d801b89` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8c1950cb90bf35f15139272d93aed5157d9e813e`
Local-runs: probe — what the host hands the gate on an update of a stored extension is not readable from the lint diff; head tree exported with `git archive` under the scratchpad, checkout untouched
Scope: `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts` (comment only), `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-door-computed-field-expression-judged.ts`, `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`, `.changeset/33072-object-extension-door-formula.md` (declaration lines and prose) + read at head: `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/{protocol-authoring-gate.ts,runtime-authoring-gate.ts,protocol-object-extension-item.ts,protocol-meta-item-reads.ts,metadata-diagnostics.ts}`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (`listItems`, `ObjectExtensionFoldOptions`), `packages/spec/src/migrations/types.ts`, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`

Check-runs at review time (2026-11-13T16:27Z): 67 runs, 56 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state` clean. `main` moved `9433d4f3` → `5c005e0e` with no change to any path of this diff.

Local runs at head, in the scratch tree: `@objectstack/lint` 202 files / 8625 tests pass; the PR body's `-t "#33072"` command 10 pass; `meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` 26 pass; five `metadata-protocol` gate and extension files 296 pass; `packages/spec/src/migrations/` 198 pass. Dropping `object_extension` from `runtimeTypes` in the scratch copy turns 8 of 49 red (the dev's ablation 1); restored byte-identical. A reviewer probe of 11 cases drove the real `saveMetaItem` + `publishMetaItem` over better-sqlite3 and the real registry; ① cites it.

### ① Derived judgments

- Roster: `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor('object_extension')` answers `validateStackExpressions`, `validateSecurityRoleWord`. The early return sits inside `runStackExpressionPasses`, so the vocabulary rule still runs (probe: `role__c` → 422 `security-role-word`). **Right.**
- One pass: on that write the flow loop and the object walk read `[]`, the #32875 extension walk runs, and `return issues` (`validate-expressions.ts:4043`) precedes the remaining passes. Three fences and one return: no second walk, no second fold. **Right.**
- Other writes: `extensionWrite` is false for every other write type and for the CLI; the three edited expressions then reduce to the merge-base text. **Right.**
- Snapshot: `{ objects, permissions, books, datasets, objectExtensions: [item] }`; `objects` is `registry.listItems('object')` plus stored object rows, narrowed to the written package's closure. The item gate refuses an unregistered or out-of-closure target by the same predicate, so a registry-backed door always carries the target with its declared fields. **Right.**
- Door equals build on one shared input: 8 bodies through the real door give the same verdict, rule id, `where`, `path` and message as `runAuthoringRules('build', …)`. Each refusal is `422 INVALID_METADATA`, `expression-invalid` at `object 'crm_account' · objectExtensions[0] · field 'score__c' expression`. **Right.**
- Served, not declared: a field another package's extension adds resolves at the door, and a field the write redefines is judged on the written definition. **Right.**
- Update of a stored extension: the door judges against the target as served before the write. **Wrong on two shapes, S1.**
- Differential: the baseline holds no `objectExtensions`, so every finding on the written entry is the write's. A field stored bad before this gate blocks every later publish of the same per-target row that re-sends it; this is the gate's rule for a finding on the written item (#22118), and the changeset's "judged only when it is published again" covers it. **Right.**
- No export moves. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is correct: a runtime door newly refuses, and no published schema or exported signature moves. `lint` minor + `spec` minor with the BREAKING banner matches #33070. The entry has the five `SemanticMigration` fields, and the `adr-0087: registered` id equals the entry id. Every changeset bullet holds except where S1 limits "refuses an extension whose computed field carries an `expression` `os build` refuses". `Skills-docs: none` does not hold (S2).

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- The claim's bare `no` versus `no (narrowing)`: the arm is correct and is what `narrowed` requires.
- File surface: `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` is outside the listed surface. Acceptable: test only (+42 lines), the publish door's own file, the end-to-end pin the order asks for, declared in the dev report. Production change is confined to `packages/lint` plus the semantic entry.
- Exposure, verified: `examples/app-showcase` one entry with three plain fields; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` one entry with one `secret` field; `packages/apps/**` none; HotCRM `0009f58` none. 0 newly refused.
- Dev out-of-scope, confirmed and not filed: an extension's `validations` are judged at neither door, yet the registry registers them on the object. The seat decides on a card.
- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

Reusing the build's walk behind a write-type fence is the right shape: one judge, the registry entry declares the type, the gate owns no judgment. What is not yet right is the universe: an extension's stored self lives folded inside `objects`, so the candidate is not the object as served after the write (S1).

No must-fix. Two should-fix:

- S1 · the door judges an update against the target as served BEFORE the write. `registry.listItems('object')` already folds the written package's stored extension of the target; `objectsAsServed` overlays the written entry by field name and cannot take out what the write drops, and `refuseUndeclaredHopField` reads the live object. Two measured disagreements with the build on one body:
  - Lenient: publish `{ bonus__c: number, total__c: formula 'record.amount + record.bonus__c' }`, then publish the entry without `bonus__c`. The door answers 200 and the registry then serves `total__c` with no `bonus__c`. The build refuses that body.
  - Strict: publish `{ ref__c: lookup → crm_region }`, then `{ ref__c: lookup → crm_account, via__c: formula 'record.ref__c.name' }`. The door answers 422 `unknown field name on crm_region`. The build accepts the body.

  Rework: hand the gate the target without the written package's own stored extension of it (the registry already answers a fold without one package's contributions, `withoutExtensionsOf`), with a pin per direction on the real door. If deferred, the changeset, the entry and the `[#33072]` docblocks must state the limit.
- S2 · `Skills-docs: none` is not true of the docs. `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx:497` gives the CEL row's runtime column as `✓ᶠᵃᶜʰᵒᵛᵖ`, where each superscript is a write type the rule inspects; at head the rule also inspects `object_extension` (`ᵒˣ`), and lines 601–609 describe that door as running the vocabulary rule only. Rework: add `ᵒˣ` and a sentence.

Nits:

- N1 · a served `object_extension` draft's `_diagnostics` now carries the verdict (`draftPublishVerdict` reads the same roster). No prose face names it.
- N2 · location parity is index-exact only for a one-entry stack; the changeset's "located where the build locates it" and the entry's `reason` do not say so. The entry's `acceptanceCriteria` alternative "or run `os validate` on the package that ships it" is weaker than the door for a pair package validated alone.
- N3 · tests: no case publishes over a stored self (S1), none pins `label()` or a hop on the real door, none pins the draft `_diagnostics`. The "(the differential)" case passes by the object-walk fence.
- N4 · PR body: the list of incoming main commits omits three paths (none in this diff); "an extension of an object outside the written package's closure …" describes an arm the item gate refuses first.

S1 and S2 are owed before landing; this reviewer delta-reviews the fix head.

Reviewed-by: `subagent of session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ac6dd79dc321ad0b6d8c2bd4f3f87ebf96803ae7`
Local-runs: probe — the two S1 shapes and the reach of the fold option are verdicts of the real door over a stored self, not readable from the diff; fix head exported with `git archive` under the scratchpad, checkout untouched
Scope: delta review of record 6858831273 (head `8c1950cb`) and amendments 6858847138 / 6858898742. Delta files: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`, `protocol-stored-collection-fold.ts`, `protocol-object-extender-fold.ts`, `protocol.ts` (the two private wrappers), `protocol-authoring-gate.extension-write-fold.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-door-computed-field-expression-judged.ts`, `.changeset/33072-object-extension-door-formula.md`, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` + what the 14 merged `main` commits changed on the PR's paths (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, `authoring-rules.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, and the new `packages/lint/src/formula-cycle-issues.ts`) + read at head: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (`getAllObjects`, `resolveObjectLeavingExtensionsOut`, `registerObjectExtension`), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/{runtime-authoring-gate.ts,protocol-publish-batch.ts}`, every other caller of the two folds

Check-runs at review time (2026-11-13T21:03Z): 68 runs, 58 success, 10 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. The PR is a draft, `mergeable_state` clean. `main` moved `bf02d33b` → `702c562c`; the only PR path it touches is `authoring-rules.ts` (`userTextParams` pass-throughs on other entries).

Local runs at head, in the scratch tree: `@objectstack/lint` 205 files / 8751 tests pass; `meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` 29 pass; nine `metadata-protocol` files (the new helper file among them) 331 pass; `packages/spec/src/migrations/` 198 pass. Both of the dev's ablations reproduce: with the host narrowing off the three republish pins go red, with the stored half off only the stored-row pin does; both restored byte-identical, 6 of 6 green again. A reviewer probe of 18 cases drove the real save, publish and batch-publish doors at BOTH heads (`8c1950cb` and `ac6dd79d`); ① cites it.

### ① Derived judgments

- S1, lenient direction: publish `{ bonus__c: number, total__c: formula 'record.amount + record.bonus__c' }`, then publish the entry without `bonus__c`. The door now answers 422 `expression-invalid`, `unknown field bonus__c on crm_account`, at `object 'crm_account' · objectExtensions[0] · field 'total__c' expression`, deep-equal to the build's finding on that body, and the registry stays as published. It answered 200 at `8c1950cb`. **Right.**
- S1, strict direction: publish `{ ref__c: lookup → crm_region }`, then `{ ref__c: lookup → crm_account, via__c: formula 'record.ref__c.name' }`. The door now answers 200 and the build has 0 findings. It answered 422 at `8c1950cb`. The same shape on a target that has its own stored object row also moved 422 → 200. **Right.**
- Everything else the probe ran gives the same answer at both heads: the 8 shared inputs still equal the build; a legacy bad field re-sent still blocks; `role__c` is still refused; a field the write redefines is judged on the written definition. The draft read's `_diagnostics` follows the narrowed verdict (the draft without `bonus__c` reads `valid: false`). **Right.**
- Reach, callers: `foldStoredCollection` has one caller, the gate, which states `targetFold` only for the `object` collection on an `object_extension` write. The five other callers of `foldObjectExtendersFromRegistry` (item, layered and list reads) pass at most four arguments and the PR does not touch them. `objectExtensionWriteFold` answers `undefined` for every other type and for a write naming no package. **Right.**
- Reach, by name: the registry option is package-wide (`isLeftOutExtension` matches the package on every object), and `withTargetFoldedWithout` takes only the target from the narrowed list. Probe: the pair's own `tier__c` on `crm_region` stays visible to its `crm_account` extension on a first publish and on a republish (`record.region.tier__c` 200, `record.region.nope__c` 422), and another package's `mod_tier` on the target stays visible on a republish, in both directions. **Right.**
- Registry semantics: a package holds one `extend` contributor per object (`registerObjectExtension` replaces it), so leaving the package out of the target's fold removes exactly the stored self. An object the package does not extend still reaches the cached `resolveObject`, so the second list costs a re-fold of the objects that package extends and nothing more. **Right.**
- Other writes: an `object` publish of a target the pair also extends gives the same verdict at both heads. **Right.**
- No published surface moves: neither helper nor `StoredCollectionTargetFold` is on the package entry, and the two class methods are private. **Right.**
- S2: row 497 reads `✓ᶠᵃᶜʰᵒˣᵒᵛᵖ`, which the legend's longest-first rule reads as flow, action, hook, object_extension, object, view, page (after `ᵖ` it would have read as `position`). The sentence at 609–612 matches the code, and the changeset line names the docs edit. **Holds in the tree.**
- N2: the changeset and the entry state index parity for a package with one entry, `reason` names the republish semantics, and `acceptanceCriteria` no longer offers `os validate`. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

Unchanged and still correct: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `lint` minor + `spec` minor with the BREAKING banner. The new republish bullet holds against the probe. The entry's `replacement` ("an `expression` `os build` accepts") now holds on the single-item door; S3 is the one door where it does not.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Surface: the delta stays inside amendments 6858847138 / 6858898742 (four `metadata-protocol` files, the docs page, the runtime test) plus the new helper test. No `packages/lint` production line moved in the delta.
- PR body: still the first head's text. False at this head: `Skills-docs: none — …`, "The host side needed no change", "No production file outside `packages/lint` changes", "All readings at HEAD `8c1950cb`", and a "What changes" list with no `metadata-protocol` or docs file. The seat's paste of the acceptance notes has to cover all five before landing.
- From the merge, `validate-expressions.ts`: #33108 put the formula-cycle member inside the object walk, which this PR fences on an extension write. The member reports declared field names only and the extension walk has no cycle member. Probe: a formula an extension adds that reads itself, or two that read each other, publishes at the door and has 0 findings at the build, while the same formula on a declared object is refused at both. The two doors agree, so this PR's claim holds; the gap belongs to #33108 × #32875. A cycle closed through a declared formula is named by the build at the declared member and not by the extension door. The seat decides on a card.
- From the merge, the rest: `authoring-rules.ts` gains `userTextParams` pass-throughs on two other entries; `protocol.ts` gains `readMetaItemFace` host members and a docblock; three new semantic entries, no id clash. `main` changed nothing in the overlay merge, the registry, `object-graph.ts`, `runtime-gate.ts`, the item gate or the save and publish doors.
- Seen by the object-write control, same at both heads, not this diff, one reproduction each: an object's own formula cannot read a field its package's published extension adds (`unknown field` at the object door, while the build accepts), and the object save's destructive-change guard reads such a field as removed unless forced.
- Carried: an extension's `validations` are judged at neither door (the seat decides on a card).
- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

The fix is the right shape. It composes two answers of the registry's own fold by name, adds no fold of its own, and makes the candidate the target as it will be served after the write. Passing the option through the stored fold is needed, as the stored-row ablation shows.

No must-fix. S1 is closed. S2 is closed in the tree; its PR-body line waits on the seat. One should-fix, new at this head's review:

- S3 · the batch publish door refuses a package whose extension drafts depend on each other. Outside the delta and the same at both heads; my first record read that the batch's pending set carries no extension drafts and did not probe it. Shape: the pair drafts `{ extend: 'crm_region', fields: { tier__c } }` and `{ extend: 'crm_account', fields: { score__c: formula 'record.region.tier__c' } }`, then `publishPackageDrafts`. The answer is `INVALID_METADATA`, `unknown field tier__c on crm_region`, and the all-or-nothing batch rolls back both. The build accepts both entries (0 findings, with or without the base in the stack), and publishing the region extension first through the per-item door then accepts the other. Before this PR the extension door ran no formula judgment, so nothing refused that batch (derived, not run on a pre-PR tree). The object door has the same blind spot on `main` (an object draft hopping into a field a sibling extension draft adds is refused the same way), so the gap is the batch's pending set, which #10377 built so a package is judged as one unit. Rework, either: thread the batch's extension drafts into the gate's universe, or state the limit in the changeset and the entry and file a card for the pending set covering both doors. The second is prose only.

Nits:

- N1, N4 · carried as the dev's notes state them.
- N3 · partly closed: a hop is now pinned on the real door. `label()` and the draft `_diagnostics` are still unpinned, and no real-door case pins "the package's extension of another object stays served" (a unit pin over hand-built arrays only; probed here, it holds).
- N5 · the class docblocks of `foldStoredCollection` and `foldObjectExtendersFromRegistry`, which the moved bodies name as their contract, do not describe the new optional parameters. `foldObjectExtendersFromRegistry` drops `onlyExtensionsOf` when both are given, though the registry accepts both; no caller passes both.
- N6 · the changeset frontmatter names `lint` and `spec` only, while `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` now carries the host half. The fixed group moves its version anyway; its changelog will not carry the line.
- N7 · `Skills-docs: none owed — …` is not one of the four listed spellings; `updated here` is the listed one for a docs edit in the PR. The seat's amendment allowed it.

S3 is owed before landing. If it is resolved by prose and a card, this record continues under the prose-only head-move rule; a code fix owes a delta review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：运行时发布对象扩展（`object_extension`）时，现在会像 `os build` 一样判定扩展新增的计算字段表达式；写错字段名、调用未注册函数等会被拒（422 `INVALID_METADATA`）。重新发布同一个扩展时，按“去掉本包旧扩展后的目标对象”来判，和 build 一致。
- 为什么改：以前这扇门不判公式，build 会拒的扩展在 Studio 里能发布，到运行时才出错。
